entries.text: Gardiner’s first St John Passion already finds the period-instrument drama that later remakes would chase: mixed choir, sharp turba pacing, Rolfe Johnson’s Evangelist in a clean English lyric line. Some tempi push hard; the continuity of the Passion holds. Later live remakes exist and some prefer them — this remains the studio benchmark those readings had to outgrow.
